$comment: An example team setup for Berth (schema berth.team/v1), made from a real run of Cal.com's. Cal.com's own setup lives privately; this one sets a box up for the public calcom/cal.com. Berth reads <org>/.berth/team.json. Placeholders are in README.md; no secrets live here.
name: Cal.com
description: Everything a Cal.com engineer needs on their box: system updates, Docker, gh and 1Password CLIs, Node and Yarn, Postgres and Redis in Docker, then cal.com cloned, migrated and seeded, with a database of its own for every worktree.

box.$os: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 12 are tested first; macOS (Homebrew with OrbStack, Docker Desktop or Colima) is best effort.
box.$settings_why: The one place these versions live; Berth gives them to box/setup.sh as BERTH_SETTING_CAL_POSTGRES_VERSION and BERTH_SETTING_CAL_REDIS_VERSION, and by hand it reads them from here. Postgres 18 is what cal.com's CI services (.github/workflows/*.yml) and its own local compose (packages/prisma/docker-compose.yml) run; 19 is still beta. Redis 8 is what cal.com's redis:latest (CI e2e-api-v2.yml, apps/api/v2/docker-compose.yaml) resolves to today, pinned to its major. A new Postgres major does not move existing data: the step says how.

steps.title: System updates
steps.detail: apt-get update and upgrade (brew update on macOS); counts as done for 24 hours

steps.title: System packages
steps.detail: git, curl, jq, unzip, build tools, python3, openssl, and psql and pg_dump of the Postgres version (PostgreSQL apt repository)

steps.title: Docker
steps.detail: Docker Engine from Docker's apt repository, started at boot, and you in the docker group

steps.title: GitHub CLI and 1Password CLI
steps.detail: gh for the box's own GitHub sign-in and clones; op for the shared keys

steps.title: Node with fnm
steps.detail: the version cal.com names (.nvmrc, engines, else its CI), in your home folder, on the PATH of login shells

steps.title: Postgres in Docker
steps.detail: cal-postgres, the version in box.settings (18), on 127.0.0.1:5450, database calendso, volume cal-postgres-data, restarts unless stopped

steps.title: Redis in Docker
steps.detail: cal-redis, the version in box.settings (8), on 127.0.0.1:6379, volume cal-redis-data, restarts unless stopped

projects.$id: The project's name on the box. The cal-com kit puts it in each worktree's URL (<worktree>.cal.<box>.localhost), so it has no dots.
projects.$repo: The public calcom/cal.com. Cal.com's own setup, kept privately, is where its team decides which repos an engineer gets.
projects.$kit: Used only while calcom/cal.com has no .berth/config.json of its own. Pinned to berth-kit-calcom's main at 5476af4.
projects.init_detail: once in the main checkout: Node from fnm, .env from .env.example with DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL at the Docker services, yarn install (prisma generate), prisma migrate deploy, seed-basic
projects.first_task: Find an open issue labelled "good first issue" in calcom/cal.com, explain how you'd fix it, and make the change in a new worktree

keys.$comment: No secrets in git. shared: op:// references, read on the box with the engineer's own 1Password when a worktree needs them. ask: each engineer's own, asked for once and kept on their box. Ports, URLs and databases are the kit's job, not this. OPEN: the vault (Engineering) and item names are placeholders.
